playbookOutputs: SARS Customs client number (exporter code) issued via RLA
RLA approval notification / customs registration letter
Note on exporter obligations (zero-rating evidence, ITAC export permits for controlled goods, certificates of origin)
playbookCommonFailures: No active registered representative on the entity's SARS profile — RLA will not accept the application
Cell number on the SARS profile cannot be verified against the entity or representative
Bank confirmation letter or proof of address in a director's personal name rather than the applicant entity's
Tax compliance status not in good standing at the time of RLA submission
Goods are controlled (e.g. scrap metal, minerals, certain agricultural products) and need an ITAC export permit the client did not budget for

informationToProvide.label: Company Registration Documents (CIPC CoR 14.3)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the company CoR 14.3 registration certificate.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3 (or CK1/CK2) showing the registered name, enterprise number and active directors.

informationToProvide.label: Certified SA ID Copies of All Directors / Members (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload certified SA ID copies (< 3 months) for all active directors.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC/SARS KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS. Foreign nationals may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of Physical Business Address (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload proof of the physical business street address (< 3 months) in the entity name.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof of the PHYSICAL business address dated within 3 months, in the entity name. Customs will not accept a P.O. Box or virtual office.

informationToProvide.label: Bank Confirmation Letter in the Name of the Business or Individual (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload an official stamped or QR-verified bank confirmation letter in the applicant name (< 3 months).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official Bank Account Confirmation Letter from a registered South African bank in the APPLICANT name dated within 3 months.

informationToProvide.label: Invoice, Sworn Affidavit, or Accountant Letter Confirming the Cellphone Number Linked to the Entity SARS Profile
informationToProvide.helpText: SARS RLA requires proof of the cellphone number on SARS Registered Details (cellphone invoice or commissioned affidavit).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Cellphone invoice, commissioned affidavit, or accountant letter confirming the cellphone number on SARS Registered Details.

informationToProvide.label: Detailed Description of Goods to be Exported, HS Tariff Codes (if known), Destination Countries & Expected Annual Export Value
informationToProvide.helpText: Describe the goods to be exported, destination countries, expected annual export turnover, and whether a clearing agent will be used.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Plain description of the goods, destination countries and HS/tariff codes if known.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Username
informationToProvide.helpText: Primary eFiling username for your personal or company profile. Please ensure the username is active.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Password
informationToProvide.helpText: ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Please test your password on sarsefiling.co.za before submitting to avoid delays or account lockouts. (Stored encrypted at rest).

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling OTP Required? (Yes / No)
informationToProvide.helpText: Specify Yes or No (does your eFiling login trigger an SMS OTP or SARS Mobile App push notification?).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Confirmation of whether SARS eFiling login requires multi-factor authentication (OTP/App push).

informationToProvide.label: Best Time to Contact for SARS OTP
informationToProvide.helpText: Select preferred date, time slot, and direct phone number so our team can coordinate live OTP approval.
informationToProvide.conditionalQuestion: If OTP is required, when is the best time and number to contact you?
informationToProvide.aiHint: Client preferred date, time window, and contact number for live OTP coordination.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect RLA supporting documents and credentials
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All required uploads received, goods/destinations and cell number captured
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Name each document and why Customs needs it. Stress: bank letter and address proof in the applicant's name within 3 months; an active registered representative must already exist on SARS; the cell number must be provable (ask for a cellphone invoice or affidavit up front). Ask whether a clearing/forwarding agent will be used. Do not promise faster than 1-2 working days for our submission — Customs approval can take longer.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Check registered representative, cell number and compliance status on eFiling
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Active registered representative confirmed; cell number on SARS Registered Details matches the one supplied; TCS Compliant
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Under SARS Registered Details confirm: (1) registered representative active — if not, stop and propose the Tax Representative Appointment service; (2) cell number on the profile equals the number supplied — if not, the RAV01 contact details must be updated first (OTP; hand off to Kevin); (3) Tax Compliance Status Compliant — if not, draft a client message listing what is outstanding. Never attempt OTP or CAPTCHA.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify documents against Customs RLA requirements
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All uploads pass the rules engine or are approved by Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Entity is the exporter, not the ordering contact. Bank letter and address must be in the entity's name; CoR14.3 must match. Check the goods list for controlled exports and note it for the deliver step. If no cell-number proof exists, draft the accountants_letter for Kevin's signature.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Prepare RLA exporter application hand-off sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Hand-off sheet with every RLA field value and the document upload list posted for Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Fields (RLA 'Exporter' client type — DA185 equivalent): applicant details, income tax and VAT numbers, physical and postal address, contact person and cell, bank details, nature of goods / tariff description, destination countries, whether a clearing agent will be used and its customs code, expected annual export value. Fill from verified facts only; leave unknowns blank and flag.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Submit exporter registration on eFiling RLA
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: RLA application staged with all documents attached; Kevin submits and the RLA reference number is recorded
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Path: eFiling > Customs > Registration Licensing and Accreditation (RLA) > New Application > Client type 'Exporter' (⚠ verify current menu names). Stage all values from the hand-off sheet, attach: CoR14.3, certified ID of representative, bank letter, proof of address, cell-number proof. Screenshot each screen and stop for Kevin to submit. Record the reference number.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for Customs approval
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Customs client number issued on RLA dashboard / approval notification received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check the RLA dashboard status at each follow-up. Customs may request additional documents; if so create a proposal for Kevin and a plain client message. Escalate via the Customs contact centre with the reference number if no movement by day 10.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver customs client number and obligations note
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Customs code, approval notice and guidance posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain: give the customs client number to the forwarding/clearing agent, keep export documentation (SAD500, bill of lading, proof of payment) for 5 years — it is also the evidence for zero-rating exports for VAT — and that controlled goods need an ITAC permit. Offer the import licence if they trade both ways.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
